MiscCleanupNotice: After a successful move, emptied source folders will go to the Recycle Bin. Folders with remaining files will be kept.
PasteHint: Open the destination folder and choose Paste (Ctrl+V).
PasteEmpty: Select files and choose Cut (Ctrl+X) first.
AlreadyThere: Files are already in this folder.
PatternHelp:
yyyy / yy: year · MM or mm: month · dd: day
Use \ for folders. Put literal text in single quotes. Windows does not allow folder names ending with a dot.
ChooseSource: Choose a source folder to get started
SelectPreview: Select a photo, video or folder
InfoEmpty: Select a file to see its date and metadata
ConfirmSortBody: Files will be moved to the selected output folder. Existing files are never overwritten. Review the plan before continuing.
ConfirmDeleteBody: Selected folders include all their contents. Windows may request confirmation if the Recycle Bin is unavailable.
Name: New name
MergeHelp: All files, including nested folders, will be moved into this folder. Duplicate names receive a numeric suffix. Empty source folders are removed after a successful merge.
InvalidSelection: Select one item to rename, or two or more folders to merge.
PatternInvalid: Invalid Windows folder name. Do not use : * ? or trailing dots/spaces, reserved names or ..
PatternQuotes: Close the single quote around literal text.
OutputInvalid: Output must not equal the source or contain the source folder.
SourceChanged: The source file changed after preview. Refresh the plan.
ReparseBlocked: Symbolic links and junctions are excluded for safety.
CopyVerificationFailed: Copy verification failed; the source was kept.
DatePolicy: Date taken → embedded creation date → file modification time → file creation time. Metadata is read locally.
PreviewUnavailable: Windows cannot preview this format. Install the required codec or open the file in another application.
Portable: WinUI and .NET are bundled with the portable app. Metadata support is bundled. Photo/video decoding uses Windows codecs.
MergePattern: Range name follows the active pattern; you can edit it.
BusyClose: An operation is running. Stop it before closing.
GalleryLimit: Showing the first 300 thumbnails. Use the file list to access all files.
